description:

**What**: Switch `PaymentsClient` in `src/payments/client.ts` from the v1 base URL to the v2 base URL given in `docs/payments-v2-migration.md`, and update the expected URL in its test.
**Files**: `src/payments/client.ts`, `src/payments/client.test.ts`
**Acceptance**:
- `PaymentsClient` uses the v2 base URL from the migration doc
- `client.test.ts` asserts the v2 base URL
**Context from completed tasks**: Task 1/3 added the v2 response types in `src/payments/types.ts`.
**Learnings**: None

Files you have read:

`src/payments/client.ts`
```ts
const BASE_URL = "https://api.payments.internal/v1";

export class PaymentsClient {
  constructor(private readonly http: HttpClient) {}
  charge(request: ChargeRequest) {
    return this.http.post(`${BASE_URL}/charges`, request);
  }
}
```

`docs/payments-v2-migration.md`
```md
# Payments v2 migration

- Amounts are now `{ value, currency }` objects (see `src/payments/types.ts`).
- Endpoints keep their paths: `POST /v1/charges` becomes `POST /charges` on the v2 host.
- v2 is served from a new host, which the payments team will publish before cut-over.
- The auth header is unchanged.
```
